Requires all upper outer officers dead and both outer protected corridors clear.
Requires roadblock #2 destroyed; retain the central formation through both safe arrivals and final clearance.

battle_phases.completion_condition: At second 85 both eastern roadblocks are destroyed, both medics are deployed, and both opening outer queues are empty.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A dead vanguard removes both interception and conditional DP; an uncleared eastern block invalidates protected-route behavior and the fixed later deployments.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interceptions and western medical support without repeating the unsupported Gallus opening.
handoff_requirements: Melantha may leave only after upper opening clearance.
Midnight must survive through #4 clearance and retreat at 85 to support redeployment at 155.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla attack reciprocally from column 3.
Melantha and Midnight intercept the outer openings and clear #3 and #4.
Lancet bridges lower attrition before Ansel arrives; Hibiscus establishes upper treatment after the western upper artillery visit.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with 10 DP and eight deployment places.
survival_dependencies: Changed central positions alter engagement timing; prior opening survival is not automatically transferred.
Lancet's 200 deployment heal is credited once; no robot deployment-limit exemption is assumed.
Western medic deployment timing follows a route-based exposure hypothesis, not a supplied artillery attack-radius fact.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Roadblock #1 is destroyed by frame 3420, outer defenders are established, and artillery death is recorded by frame 5100.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Missing clearance or caster survival refutes the artillery budget. An artillery survivor invalidates the protected-route and terminal-medical assumptions.
battle_phases.goal: Complete the first protected corridor and kill the artillery before its western return threatens the medical formation.
handoff_requirements: Gallus must finish #1 before giving Cardigan his slot.
Lava must deliver actual artillery damage before withdrawal.
Steward's withdrawal requires an actual artillery death, not the civilian-death event previously misread.
responsibilities: Gallus attacks #1 while the artillery is east.
Steward and Lava divide eastern firing coverage without column-3 blocked targets competing.
Noir Corne and Cardigan intercept outer officers at column 4.
Beagle and Spot replace the central vanguards before the final rush.
battle_phases.start_condition: Both medics and Steward are deployed and opening outer clearance permits the scheduled withdrawals.
survival_dependencies: Each caster has one normal medical anchor; standoff must actually reduce incoming pressure enough for survival.
A single medic is not presumed sufficient against uninterrupted 1000-ATK impacts; actual impact and healing events must validate this structure.
The DP ledger assumes every scheduled vanguard payout occurs while its operator survives.

battle_phases.completion_condition: All spawns through second 211 are exhausted, lower outer clearance permits Cardigan's retirement, and returning Steward begins terminal cleanup.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Overflow creates a leak even if protected targets survive. Premature defender retirement removes the separation protecting the detained second civilian.
battle_phases.goal: Contain every final hostile spawn and clear armored queues with geographically separated arts.
handoff_requirements: Steward remains absent for at least 70 seconds after retreat at 175.
Cardigan retires at 260 only after actual lower outer clearance.
Noir Corne remains until upper outer clearance is independently confirmed.
responsibilities: Beagle and Midnight provide five upper blocking places across their adjacent tiles.
Midnight uses arts from 195; his DOWN range excludes Spot's lower tile.
Spot holds the lower queue while Durin attacks continuously from the LEFT-facing lower position.
Both medics retain their row-group duties and outer defenders remain until their queues are empty.
battle_phases.start_condition: Central defenders are installed; Midnight redeploys at 155 after his completed cooldown.
survival_dependencies: Midnight must survive the charging interval and subsequent arts downtime.
Defender survival uses listed base DEF and HP; unsupported healing or defensive talents are excluded.
Blocked enemy counts must remain within available capacity; delayed kills are acceptable only while containment survives.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both expected civilians have safely arrived, protected deaths and leaks are zero, remaining life is positive, spawns are exhausted and no active enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A protected death, missing arrival, leak or surviving hostile prevents project acceptance regardless of the other metrics.
battle_phases.goal: Safely release the second civilian and finish every remaining hostile queue.
handoff_requirements: Confirm both arrivals by protected-target identifiers rather than kill counts.
Do not stop at exhausted spawns while enemies remain blocked.
responsibilities: Melantha destroys #2 from [6,3] LEFT after upper outer clearance.
Steward, Midnight and Durin finish surviving central enemies.
Beagle, Spot and both medics remain until hostile clearance is complete.
battle_phases.start_condition: The artillery is dead, the lower outer queue is empty, and Steward has returned for central cleanup.
survival_dependencies: Melantha's 70-to-300 and Steward's 175-to-260 retreat paths provide completed cooldowns.
No officer may remain within attack reach of the released or detained civilian.
Operator deaths are recorded separately and never substituted for protected-target acceptance.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward owns upper eastern artillery damage, Lava owns the lower segment, and opening Midnight contributes only confirmed incidental arts hits. Require the actual artillery death by frame 5100.
Melantha destroys #3; Gallus destroys #1. Noir Corne intercepts later upper outer officers east of the civilian. Confirm this civilian's safe arrival independently.
Opening Midnight destroys #4. Keep #2 intact while Cardigan intercepts subsequent officers at column 4. Melantha later destroys #2 after clearance.
Fang hands upper central containment to Beagle. Midnight adds two-block capacity and upper-only damage; returning Steward finishes armored survivors.
Vanilla hands lower containment to Spot. Durin supplies uninterrupted lower arts after the artillery phase.
Melantha handles the opening; Noir Corne holds every later upper outer officer until death. Retirement requires an empty queue after the final spawn.
Opening Midnight handles the initial lower pair; Cardigan holds every subsequent lower outer officer until the queue is empty.

Opening lower interception and reciprocal upper attacks.
Opening upper outer interception and roadblock #3 clearance.
Opening lower outer interception, roadblock #4 clearance and incidental artillery damage during opening arts.
Opening global recovery and temporary lower treatment before the artillery approaches column 5.
Western upper medical anchor covering the upper blockers, Gallus and Steward.
Upper eastern artillery firing position; its range excludes the column-3 central blocking tiles.
Western lower medical anchor covering lower interception and the lower firing position.

Lower eastern artillery damage; credit individual hits only.
Permanent upper outer interception east of the western civilian restraint.
Permanent lower outer interception east of the second civilian's western restraint.
Lower central three-block anchor using ordinary attacks only.
Upper central damage and additional blocking; attack geometry excludes the lower blocking tile.
Continuous lower arts covering [4,3] while excluding upper row 3.
Returning terminal arts support after the artillery withdrawal cooldown.
Final roadblock #2 clearance after all outer officers are cleared.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward [2,5] RIGHT and Lava [5,5] RIGHT divide upper and lower eastern coverage. Central blocked enemies at column 3 are outside both firing ranges. Incoming enemies may still compete while crossing those ranges; no target priority is assumed.
formation_structure.clearance: Midnight supplies upper-only damage and additional capacity from second 155. Durin supplies continuous lower-only arts from second 175. Returning Steward later removes remaining armored queues.
formation_structure.containment: Beagle and Spot replace the central vanguards. Noir Corne and Cardigan hold the outer corridors at column 4, separating officers from civilians detained at column 2.
formation_structure.medicine: Hibiscus [2,2] RIGHT and Ansel [5,2] RIGHT each treat their own row group from three columns behind its caster. They do not provide reciprocal healing. Lancet supplies the opening lower bridge and withdraws before the artillery approaches.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla intercept at column 3 and retain reciprocal attacks. Melantha and Midnight handle the two outer openings and their eastern roadblocks.
formation_structure.release: Gallus clears #1 during the eastern artillery excursion. Melantha clears #2 only after both outer queues have been verified empty.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Lancet after the opening recovery bridge; reserve [5,5] for later artillery damage.
Withdraw Melantha after roadblock #3 and the opening upper outer queue are cleared.
Establish the lower western medic after the artillery has moved east of its lower western endpoint.
Assign Gallus to roadblock #1 while the artillery is away from the western medical cluster.
Withdraw opening Midnight after roadblock #4 and the initial lower outer queue are cleared; begin his 70-second redeployment interval.
Withdraw Gallus only with roadblock #1 destroyed; his slot passes to Cardigan.
Replace Fang with Beagle on the same upper central tile.
Replace Vanilla with Spot after the final scheduled DP activation.
Withdraw Lava after the lower eastern firing opportunity; her slot passes to returning Midnight.
Deploy Midnight after exactly 70 seconds of cooldown; upper arts becomes ready at second 195.
After the mandatory artillery kill, withdraw Steward and establish Durin's lower clearance position.
After the lower outer queue is empty, Cardigan releases her slot to returning Steward.
After the upper outer queue is empty, Noir Corne releases his slot to Melantha for final civilian release.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected identity has rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true. Use only listed legal tiles and never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
At most eight deployed operators. Count no refunds, unsupported DP talents or income after its generating operator is withdrawn or dead.
Both central vanguards must survive to their scheduled defender handoffs. Lancet's lower bridge and the later medic deployments are survival dependencies, not guaranteed arithmetic credits.
Roadblocks #3 and #4 must be destroyed before their opening guards withdraw; #1 must be destroyed before Gallus withdraws at frame 3420.

Observe actual death of enemy_1112_emppnt#0 by frame 5100. Actual applied damage must close all 13000 HP, covering at least the prior 4714.53 shortfall. Do not equate deployment duration or theoretical firing opportunities with damage.

The western medics must survive the artillery excursion. Two-tile caster standoff is a hypothesis, not established immunity. Before an artillery impact, each affected operator requires HP strictly greater than its actual incoming damage; failed survival invalidates downstream duties.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Keep officers outside their supported 1.2 attack radius of detained civilians; do not infer civilian safety solely from operator blocking.
Retirement requires the assigned queue or roadblock to be cleared. Midnight's 85-to-155 and Steward's 175-to-260 retreat/redeployment paths must remain intact.
Frames are fixed. If a prerequisite fails, classify the candidate as failed rather than silently delaying actions, inventing replacement tactics or crediting commands to dead operators.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Preserve reciprocal central interception, complete the eastern upper release, bridge lower healing with Lancet, and establish western medics after the artillery passes their endpoints.
Clear #1, complete #4, establish both eastern firing positions and install outer defenders before the paired officers reach column 4.
Deliver the complete artillery kill while replacing both central vanguards and deploying Midnight. The firing-position standoff must produce surviving casters, not merely legal deployments.
Keep five upper blocking places across Beagle and Midnight, three lower places on Spot, and both outer anchors. Midnight's first arts window and Durin's continuous damage must prevent overflow.
Finish outer queues and sustain central armored containment. Release Cardigan's slot to Steward only after actual lower outer clearance.
Destroy #2 without an officer remaining in the protected corridor, confirm the second arrival, and retain central damage and medicine until all hostile queues are empty.

tactical_thesis: Separate artillery firing, medicine and interception geometrically. Move both opening central blockers to column 3, retain their reciprocal attacks, and place the artillery casters in column 5 facing RIGHT. Establish western medical anchors only after the artillery leaves their respective western endpoints. Clear roadblock #1 with Gallus during the artillery's eastern excursion. Replace central vanguards with defenders before the armored waves, establish Midnight's upper-only clearance before the final rush, and retain the western civilian restraint until the outer officer queues are cleared. This is an untested structural hypothesis; caster survival and the artillery kill are mandatory validation gates.
